articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 14, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) expects to release its 2026 second quarter results after 5:00 p.m. (ET) on Tuesday, August 4, 2026. The release will be available shortly thereafter on AFG’s website at www.AFGinc.com.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces Its Conference Call and Webcast to Discuss 2026 Second Quarter Results

articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 1, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) announced that it has declared a regular dividend of $0.88 per share of American Financial Group Common Stock. The dividend is payable on July 24, 2026, to holders of record on July 15, 2026.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
